# mlxtrx

mlxtrx launches Monolix, PKanalix and Simulx runs and keeps a record of
each one: what ran, with which settings and files, when, and by whom.
Every file is fingerprinted by its SHA-256 hash, so at any time you can
ask whether the results on disk still match the files that produced
them.

- Launch many models in one call, on the grid (`mono24`, `pk24`,
  `sim24`) or locally (`monolix.sh`, `pkanalix.sh`, `simulx.sh`).
- Detect whether each run succeeded and extract its fit statistics.
- Get one condition per model, file or folder: never run, failed,
  unfinished, inputs changed, output edited, or clean.
- Check the export settings MonolixSuite needs before launching.
- Collect every run in one sortable, exportable table.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("nash-delcamp-slp/mlxtrx")
```

## Set the run store

Runs are recorded in a store: a folder of plain JSON files, one folder
per run. Point mlxtrx at it once per session, usually from the project’s
`.Rprofile`:

``` r

options(mlxtrx.store = "/path/to/<project>/monolix/.mlxtrx")
```

Every function also takes `store =` directly. Without either, mlxtrx
stops and tells you how to set it. The store is created when the first
run is recorded.

## Launch runs

``` r

library(mlxtrx)

run_ids <- mono(c("base/run1.mlxtran", "base/run2.mlxtran"), thread = 4)
pk("nca/<study>_nca.pkx")
sim("sim/<project>_sim.smlx")
```

[`mono()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/mono.md)
and
[`pk()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/mono.md)
first check the charts-data export settings in the tool’s `config.ini`
([`check_config_ini()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/check_config_ini.md)).
All three record each run as it is submitted, wait for the grid jobs to
leave the queue, then record the outputs and statistics. The default
commands are `mono24`, `pk24` and `sim24`; set
`options(mlxtrx.monolix_cmd = )`, `mlxtrx.pkanalix_cmd` or
`mlxtrx.simulx_cmd`, or pass `cmd =`, to use another command such as a
local `monolix.sh`.

Projects built or edited with lixoftConnectors: save them with
`saveProject()`, then run them with
[`mono()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/mono.md)
or
[`pk()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/mono.md).

## Check status

``` r

run_status("base")
print_report_summary("base")
#> === RUN STATUS REPORT ===
#> Path: /path/to/<project>/monolix/base
#> ...
#> Models: 3
#>   inputs_changed  1
#>   clean           2
#>
#> Needs attention:
#>   run2.mlxtran  inputs_changed
#>     data/<study>_pk.csv modified
```

[`run_status()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/run_status.md)
returns one row per model with a single condition, most serious first:
`never_run`, `failed`, `unfinished`, `inputs_changed`, `output_edited`,
`output_suspect`, `clean_late`, `clean`. A file that no run recorded is
`untracked`. Pass a folder, a project file, or any input or output file.
[`print_report_summary()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/print_report_summary.md)
prints the same result as a report.

The `check_*()` functions answer narrower questions about project, input
and output files.

## Results table

``` r

runs_data(include_summary = TRUE, latest_only = TRUE)
runs_table(include_summary = TRUE)
runs_table(format = "csv", output_file = "runs.csv")
```

Statistics include, for Monolix, the values from `summary.txt` and
observation counts; for PKanalix, the tasks run, the number of
individuals, the compartmental analysis criteria and the bioequivalence
ratios.

## When a session dies

If the R session that launched runs ends before they finish, their
completion is not recorded. Record it later with:

``` r

finalize_runs()
```

These runs are marked as recorded late, and any output written well
after the rest of the run’s outputs is flagged as suspect.

# Package index

## Launch runs

Submit Monolix, PKanalix and Simulx projects and record each run.

- [`mono()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/mono.md)
  [`pk()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/mono.md)
  [`sim()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/mono.md)
  : Submit Monolix, PKanalix and Simulx jobs to grid and record runs in
  the run store

## Status

One condition per model, as a data frame or a printed report.

- [`run_status()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/run_status.md)
  : Report one condition per model
- [`print_report_summary()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/print_report_summary.md)
  : Print a run status report

## File checks

Per-file and per-project checks against the recorded runs.

- [`check_completion_status()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/check_completion_status.md)
  : Check completion status of project files in a directory
- [`check_project_file_status()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/check_project_file_status.md)
  : Check project file modification status
- [`check_input_file_status()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/check_input_file_status.md)
  : Check input file modification status
- [`check_output_file_status()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/check_output_file_status.md)
  : Check output file integrity
- [`check_output_files()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/check_output_files.md)
  : Check specified output files alignment with latest runs

## Results

Recorded runs and their statistics as one table.

- [`runs_data()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/runs_data.md)
  : Extract data about executed Monolix runs
- [`runs_table()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/runs_table.md)
  : Generate a table with details about executed Monolix runs
- [`get_run_files()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/get_run_files.md)
  : Get file information for specific runs

## Store and recovery

- [`default_store()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/default_store.md)
  : Get the run store path
- [`finalize_runs()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/finalize_runs.md)
  : Record completion of runs whose launching session ended

## Setup

- [`check_config_ini()`](https://nash-delcamp-slp.github.io/mlxtrx/reference/check_config_ini.md)
  : Check Monolix/PKanalix/Simulx config file
